Ἑμμώρ (T, Ἐμμώρ, Rec. -όρ indecl. (Heb. חֲמוֹר), 
 Emmor (Gen.33:19): Act.7:16.†
 (AS)

ἔξ-οδος, -ου, ὁ
 (ὁδός), [in LXX chiefly for מוֹצָא also חוּץ, etc. ;] 
a going out, departure: Heb.11:22; of death, Luk.9:31, 2Pe.1:15.†
 (AS)

ἐπειτα, adv. of sequence 
 [in LXX: Num.19:10 A, Isa.16:2, 4Ma.6:3 * ;] 
thereupon, thereafter, then: Luk.16:7, Gal.1:21, Jas.4:14; before μετὰ τοῦτο, Jhn.11:7; μετὰ ἔτη τρία, Gal.1:18; διὰ δεκατεσσάρων ἐτῶν, Gal.2:1; πρῶτον . . . ἔ., 1Co.15:46, 1Th.4:17, Heb.7:2; πρότεφον . . . ἔ, Heb.7:27; ἀπαρχὴ . . . ἔ., 1Co.15:23; εἶτα . . . ἔ., 1Co.15:5-6 (WH, txt.); . . . ἔ., 1Co.15:5-7 (WH, mg.); τρίτον . . . ἔ. (his), 1Co.12:28.†
 (AS)

ἑτοιμασία, -ας, ἡ
 (ἑτοιμάζω, which see), [in LXX for כּוּן hi., כֵּן, מָכוֹן, and cognate forms, Est.2:68 3:3, Psa.10:17 65:9 89:14, Nam.2:4, Zec.5:11, Eze.43:11, Da TH Dan.11:7, 20-21, Wis.13:12 * ;] 
__1. = ἑτοιμότης, 
 __(a) readiness (Hipp.); 
 __(b) preparation (LXX; e.g. ἑ. τ. καρδίας, Psa.10:17): Eph.6:15, EV. 
 __2. foundation, firm footing (Psa.89:14): Eph, l.with (Hatch, Essays, 55; Exp. Times, ix, 38; but see also Abbott, Essays, 95).†
 (AS)

ἦθος, -εος (-ους), τό 
 [in LXX: Sir.20:26, 4Ma.1:29 4Mac 2:7 4Mac 2:21 4Mac 5:24 4Mac 13:27 * ;] 
__1 1, a haunt, abode. 
 __2. = ἔθος, custom, manner: pl., 1Co.15:33.†
 (AS)

θεο-δίδακτος, -ον 
 taught of God (cf. διδακτοὶ θεοῦ, Jhn.6:45): 1Th.4:9.†
 (AS)

θεραπεία, -ας, ἡ
 (θεραπεύω) [in LXX for עֶבֶד Gen.45:16 (cf. Est.5:2), etc. ;] 
__1. service. 
 __2. healing: Luk.9:11 (Field, Notes, 60), Rev.22:2. 
 __3. Collective, household attendants, servants: Luk.12:42 (LXX, ll. with).†
 (AS)

θέρος, -ους, τό
 (θέρω, to heat), [in LXX chiefly for קַיִץ ;] 
summer: Mat.24:32, Mrk.13:28, Luk.21:30.†
 (AS)

καθ-ίημι 
 [in LXX: Exo.17:11 (נוּחַ hi.), and seel., 1Ch.21:27, Zec.11:13, Jer.32:14 * ;] 
to send or let down: before εἰς, Luk.5:19; διά, with genitive, ib., Act.9:25; ptcp., before ἐπί, with genitive, Act.10:11; ἐκ, Act.11:5.†
 (AS)

καύχησις, -εως, ἡ
 (καυχάομαι), [in LXX for תִּפְאָרָה (1Ch.29:13, Eze.16:12, al) ;] 
a boasting, glorying: Rom.3:27, 2Co.11:10 11:17, Jas.4:16; before ὑπέρ, 2Co.7:4 8:24; ἐτί, with genitive, 2Co.7:14; ἔχω τὴν κ. ἐν Χρ. Ἰησ., Rom.15:17; στέφανος καυχήσεως (Ez. l.with, al.), 1Th.2:19; of the cause of glorying, a boast ( = καύχημα), 2Co.1:12.†
 (AS)

κολάζω
 (κόλος, docked), [in LXX: Dan.6:12 (13) (no Heb.), I Est.8:24, Wis.3:4 (and freq.), 1Ma.7:7, al. ;] 
__1. to curtail, dock, prune. 
 __2. to check, restrain. 
 __3. to chastise, correct, punish: pass., 2Pe.2:9; mid., cause to be punished (3Ma.7:3): Act.4:21.†
 (AS)

Κρήσκης, -εντος (BI., § 10, 4), ὁ 
 Crescens: 2Ti.4:10.† 
 (AS)

μηδέποτε (μηδέ, ποτέ) 
 adv., 
never: 2Ti.3:7.†
 (AS)

μιασμός, -οῦ, ὁ
 (μιαίνω), [in LXX: Wis.14:26, 1Ma.4:43 * ;] 
__1. prop., the act of defiling. 
 __2. = μίασμα (which see) : 2Pe.2:10 (cf. Plut., Mor., 393c).†
 (AS)

ἀν-επ-αίσχυντος, -ον
 (ἐπαισχύνομαι) 
not to be put to shame: 2Ti.2:15.†
 (AS)

ποτήριον, -ου, τό dimin. of ποτήρ 
 (πίνω), [in LXX chiefly for כּוֹס:] 
a wine cup: Mat.23:25-26 26:27, Mrk.7:4 14:23, Luk.11:39 22:17, 20 a (WH, R, mg., cm.), 1Co.11:25, Rev.17:4; πίνειν ἐκ τοῦ π., 1Co.11:28; with genitive of thing(s), Mat.10:42, Mrk.9:41; τ. εὐλογίας, 1Co.10:16; by meton., of the contents of the cup, Luk.22:20 b (WH, R, mg., cm.), 1Co.11:25-26; with genitive of person(s), 1Co.10:21 11:27. Metaphorical, of experience of divine providence; of prosperity (Psa.16:5, al.); of adversity (Psa.11:6, Isa.51:17, al.): of the sufferings of Christ, Mat.20:22-23 26:39 10:38-39 14:36, Luk.22:42, Jhn.18:11; of divine punishment, Rev.14:10 16:19 18:6.†
 (AS)

πραΰτης
 (Rec. -ότης, exc. Ja, 1Pe, ll. with, where πρᾳύτης), -ητος, ἡ, late form of πραότης, [in LXX: Psa.45:4 90:10 132:1 (עַנְוָה, עֱנוּת, Est.5:1, Sir.6:1-37 * ;] 
gentleness, meekness: 1Co.4:21, 2Co.10:1, Gal.5:23 6:1, Eph.4:2, Col.3:12 (see Lft., in l), 2Ti_2:25, Tit.3:2, Jas.1:21 3:13, 1Pe.3:15.†
 SIN.: ἐπιεικία, q.v 
 (AS)

προ-γράφω 
 [in LXX: Dan LXX 3:3 cod., 1Ma.10:36 * ;] 
__1. to write before: Rom.15:4, Eph.3:3, Ju 4. 
 __2. to write in public, placard, proclaim (Dem., Plut., al.): Gal.3:1 (Lft., in l). 
 __3. = ζωγραφέω, to pourtray, depict: Ga, l.with (Syr. Pesh., Chrys.; Field, Notes, 189; CGT, in l).†
 (AS)

σαλπίζω 
 [in LXX chiefly for תָּקַע ;] 
to sound a trumpet: Rev.8:6 ff. Rev.9:1, 13 10:7 11:15; metaphorically, Mat.6:2. Impers., the trumpet sounds: 1Co.15:52.†
 (AS)

τροφή, -ῆς, ἡ
 (τρέφω), [in LXX for לֶחֶם, מָזוֹן, אֹכֶל, etc. ;] 
nourishment, food: Mat.3:4 6:25 10:10 24:45, Luk.12:23, Jhn.4:8, Act.2:46 9:19 14:17 27:33-34, 36 27:38 Jas.2:15. Metaphorical: Heb.5:12, 14.†
 (AS)

ὑακίνθινος, -η, -ον
 (ὑάκινθος), [in LXX for תַּחַשׁ, תְּכֵלֶת ;] 
of hyacinth, hyacinthine (see: ὑάκινθος), "doubtless meant to describe the blue smoke of a sulphurous flame" (Swete): Rev.9:17 (Hom., Eur., al.).†
 (AS)

ὑπόδημα, -τος, τό
 (ὑποδέω), [in LXX for נָעַל ;] 
a sole bound under the foot, a sandal: Mat.3:11 10:10, Mrk.1:7, Luk.3:16 10:4 15:22 22:35, Jhn.1:27; τ. ποδῶν, Act.7:33 (LXX) Act.13:25.†
 SYN.: σανδάλιον, q.v (AS)

ἀρτύω 
 [in Sm.: Sng.8:2 * ;] 
__1. to arrange, make ready (Hom.). 
 __2. Of food (as in comic writers), to season (MM, see word): Mrk.9:50, Luk.14:34, Col.4:6.† 
 (AS)

Ἁδραμυντηνός (T, Rec. Ἀδραμυττηνός), -ή,-όν, 
 of Adramyttium, a seaport of Mysia: Act.27:2.†
 (AS)
